fusions.name: Flung Cinder
fusions.desc: Kicks a cinder at an enemy that deals 4 fire damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wind-Fanned Flare
fusions.desc: Breathes flame 5 tiles ahead that deals 28 fire damage to everything in it, ignoring resistance, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Fever Pace
fusions.desc: Your fire damage rises by 30% for 10 seconds and your movement speed by 20% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flashpoint
fusions.desc: When non-fire damage hits you, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. You resist fire damage by 10%.
